experiments.verification: Completed-suite receipts enforced during every measured trial.

sampling.quality_gate: Unchanged supplied tests; all expected visible/held-out tests execute and pass; no skipped tests. Independent verifier runs with read-only code and no network.
sampling.aggregation: For each repeat sum both tasks; compare medians across3 repeats. Per-task arrays and every trial retained.
sampling.threshold: More than5% improvement; no greater than5% regression in required wall time.
sampling.token_metric: Total input+output tokens reported by AgenC, including cached input. No paid API usage in measurements.
sampling.latency_metric: Wall time of AgenC CLI process; independent post-run verification excluded.
sampling.inference_cache: Server caching left unchanged; no reset between runs.
